llm.summary: This is a lightweight analytical-reasoning skill that structures questions and evidence without adding hidden commands, persistence, or unusual access.

dimensions.detail: The skill may tell an agent to read relevant dashboards, logs, code, or data when available, but that is disclosed, task-directed, and proportionate to analytical investigations.
